statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is needed to correlate symptoms with rhythm changes and capture intermittent dysrhythmias
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is excluded from the patient's current coverage
